appliedUpdates.description: Added additive recovery command `openclawssy-start-no-deps: docker compose up -d --no-deps openclawssy` to capture observed startup workaround when a dependency health gate blocks `docker compose up -d openclawssy`.
Added additive command `test-ui-component-ts` for `tests/e2e/shared-components.spec.ts` to reflect current component validation path without overwriting existing command entries.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Relax rigid TDD/manual-browser requirements for small, localized UI fixes in non-interactive exec mode: allow implementation-first with immediate regression coverage and allow deterministic Playwright-only validation when it fully covers acceptance behavior.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both fix-mobile-inspector-drawer-open-path and fix-g-then-c-shortcut-sequence passed with strong scoped Playwright coverage but reported procedure deviations only due to mandatory manual-check/TDD ordering rules.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit backend-only exception path so fullstack-assigned fixes that touch only Go routes/handlers are not forced into frontend test-first/manual-frontend expectations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-dashboard-trailing-slash-spa-route was backend-only and validated correctly via Go test/vet/build, but current fullstack wording implies both-layer frontend verification as always required.

rejectedObservations.observation: Replace the primary `services.openclawssy.start` command with a `--no-deps` variant.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected: environment-specific workaround; kept default start behavior intact and captured the workaround as an additive command instead.

rejectedObservations.observation: Overwrite existing `test-ui-component` command to point to `.spec.ts`.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected: scrutiny apply-now policy for services.yaml is additive-only; added a new command key rather than mutating an existing one.
